notes.title: Patch 1.7.0 - Dreamland: Slumbering Spells
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/09901ac2fc790d556ff37dd0e7ab7fbb4988f627.png"]
Welcome to Dreamland: Slumbering Spells, an expansion of our mystical Dreamland update! 🧙✨


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7dbbbaffcfcafc82484cc2ab587b48ac28aef4b8.png"]



Introducing Sorcerer's Spire, the location where it all began: the birth spot of the witches and their fantastical lands! Explore a twisting map full of mystery and magic, and collect over 80 new Dreamland props throughout the map! We've also introduced 50+ new structures to Creative Mode, 40 new Dreamland skins, and the return of the Dreamland event with a brand new exclusive player icon. 🌙


In even bigger news, we're also launching our new standalone prop fighting game: Prop Sumo! 💥


[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ygk4a9QB7sw"][/dynamiclink]

Read on to find out more about what we've been working on! ⤵️


Sorcerer's Spire!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

Sorcerer's Spire is a mystical new map set in a spectacular observatory. It's what happens when you mix the fantastical world of Dream Valley Castle with the chaos of Twisted House! 💫



Explore the observatory - a once serene place now unleashed with magical chaos! Hunt and hide amongst the sorcerer's tools and tomes, or take flight on one of the flying books circling the central orrery! 📖



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/584c5ba8365a0e8778a282ce50af843c52607efc.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8b353b27533abb92d26fef8d5ad2fee4287aaa9b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/62af83b480805495e3ec92f764dccad1e16933d4.png"]

Drop down the centre of the spire to find a huge spiral staircase, and if you're brave enough - enter the portal at the bottom to see where it takes you! 🌀



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ac7b588edcdb7865cccaf2689ef42c2b4e1d5570.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e55cad967758718456bdf8925879398aa586e31e.png"]

As you head down the spiral staircase, you'll encounter different floors featuring familiar themes and areas from the Witch It universe. What secrets do these locations hold? 🔎



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2ee19a99e21fa39ca949a5e885bb4f00fe76e268.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0019d5446b38bb34437df11ae04201a5924f0a72.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/839f31fec40861e2da780d5eb3c4b27abba9d6d0.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/5dfe974b1393bc136273f9307c22a26e185c963f.png"]
80+ New Props!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

Blend in with the Sorcerer's Spire by transforming into 80+ new props placed throughout the map! Collect a variety of different vials, jars, stargazing tools, ingredients, furnishings and much, much more. We've even thrown in a ton of secret props to add to your prop collection! 🧪



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ec5055d1fc30f4299443dd7297bc8aad0c589d7b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e91690479a45078e1d7e7050cf762b5f101d8d1f.png"]


50+ New Structures!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

Transform your map designs with over 50 new structures, including all-new windows, pillars, foliage, banners, and even the long-requested addition of pipes! Piece together your own pipe network and finally build that Steampunk map you always wanted to create! 🔩



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/68182021dd102913a2b0ae7419d2b3e6ac463a5a.png"]


40 New Skins!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

Ascend to another dimension with these otherworldly hunter and witch sets:

⭐ Nocturnal Starseeker

🪐 Astral Cosmic Oracle

⭐ Crepuscular Starseeker

🪐 Clairvoyant Cosmic Oracle 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/207b0d9a04e069a21f305acdf17d8ddeaabe20c5.png"]

Or perhaps it's all just a dream? Cosy up in these snugly sets:

💤 Dreamy Sleepwalker

🧼 Relaxed Lounger

💤 Snuggly Sleepwalker

🧼 Languid Lounger



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/74154ddedb41ca37a64a60d30d73685a76d66e9d.png"]


Exclusive Icon!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

Collect the limited time "Sorcerer's Spire" icon by playing Witch It during the event season. At the end of the Dreamland event, this icon will never return, so make sure to pick it up before it disappears! ⌛



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9a7ac922c200c7cc55eb46f42aa41d1fa871ecaa.jpg"]


New Material Variants!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

Looking to give your map an out-of-this-world vibe? New carpet and wallpaper variants have just landed in Creative Mode! 🧵



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e083ab117dd9ac861dbc5a43c8c9a3bdf36f6d6a.png"]
Prop Sumo + Free Skin!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"]

We're extremely proud to announce our new game, Prop Sumo, which pits the props you know and love from Witch It in chaotic battles! :rollingbarrel:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a366bdde7b353ef8fc1e9ce79bc43cc8322de0ef.jpg"]

Prop Sumo is a side project we've been working on since the start of the year, and is made for peer-to-peer battles between friends. Prop Sumo arrives later this year with the "Friend Pass", which allows all members in your party to play for free (without progression) as long as the host owns the full game! ✔️ 

Prop Sumo Store Page

Sign up for the playtest on the store page today. We'll be giving access to players over the upcoming weeks so you can try the game before it launches!


Wishlist and follow Prop Sumo to receive the limited-time "Sumo" set in Witch It! 🥋


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/be64e27633e6eb69ec27f3e089a8d23a42698b7c.jpg"]

notes.title: Patch 1.6.2 - Chinese New Year 2025!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/65c2a5be7fb2bddfc02a265e8a93911c73856ae2.png

新年好! Witch It is celebrating Year of the Snake with new CNY skins, fireworks, an exclusive icon, as well as 3 special items - read on! 🧧

2 Year of the Snake Skins!
Adorn yourself in two ssslithering new items - the Lucky Snake Head for hunters, and the Wood Snake Headpiece for witches! 🐍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e5c9f7ba0aaa6ded43a136e81304314cd3e2cddb.jpg
How do I obtain Year of the Snake items?
Opening Witch It during the Chinese New Year 2025 event will grant you 30 "Fireworks"!
A Firework contains a random Chinese New Year item (including CNY items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with "Gunpowder". 💥

To earn Gunpowder, fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Gunpowder has a 50% chance of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press 'Chinese New Year' to combine it with a Firework! 🎆

Every Chinese New Year item earned through Fireworks are tradable and craftable even after the event is over. If you use up all your FIreworks, you can craft more by combining 5 Gunpowder together!
Note: Gunpowder can only be obtained in Official servers.

You can also receive the new items through:
- Random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our Discord server to find traders).

Year of the Snake Player Icon!
Celebrate the New Year with the limited time [color=#b4274a]"Year of the Snake"[/color] player icon! ✨

Play at least one round of Witch It in an Official server during the Chinese New Year 2025 event to earn the icon, but don't miss out - the icon will never return once the event is over!

Find the Snake Firework in any map decorated with Chinese lanterns. 🏮

Today, we celebrate the outstanding contributions of 3 incredible community members with 3 brand-new special items! You can earn each very rare item via crafting or trading.

[color=#eed54b]hgbf's Rubber Duck[/color]
Awarded for hgbf's incredible commitment and talent as a community moderator, as well as their exceptional work on PropViewer with fri! 🦆

[color=#66daf3]fri's Helmet[/color]
Awarded for fri's countless years of evolving Witch It's content and streaming scene, as well their magnificent efforts towards PropViewer with hgbf! ⚡

[color=#e17bd9]Jasmin's Bat Broom[/color]
Awarded for Jasmin's undeniably prodigious work on WitchTrade, an indispensable tool that has shaped Witch It's bustling trading community into what it is today! 🦇

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1 - Winterdream 2024!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Winterdream! We hope you're having a very merry Winter season so far.
Get into the festive mood with the limited-time Winterdream event, including new skins, the Winterdream 2024 player icon, and a welcome return of the event prop layouts. Enjoy! 🦌

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/41b1ab7c362797c54dcef57c794fee00a4d4c3de.png
5 New Winterdream Items!
Wrap up your characters with brand-new seasonal skins, including the [color=#c5380e]Gingerbread Face[/color], [color=#4a72c3]Blue Bobble Hat[/color] and [color=#a86c3f]Pinecone[/color] for hunters, as well as the [color=#557b49]Decorated Tree Hat[/color] and [color=#f2d0ac]Cinnamon Roll Hat[/color] for witches! 🎄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c64bae5ffff44db154e46bc61abcfffb57c44d2b.png

Opening Witch It during the Winterdream 2024 event will grant you 40 "Filled Boots"!
A Filled Boot contains a random Winterdream item (including Winterdream items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with "Cinnamon Star". ⭐

To earn Cinnamon Stars, fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Cinnamon Stars have a 60% chance of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled, but must be earned on specific Winter maps: Snowbreeze, Fiskersted, Northern Whispers, Wardwell Wintry or Singing Sanctuary. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press 'Winterdream Festival' to combine it with a Filled Boot!

Winterdream 2024 items have a 25% chance of being crafted when combining a star and a boot. Every Winterdream 2024 item earned through Filled Boots are tradable and craftable even after the event is over. If you use up all your Filled Boots, you can craft more by combining 5 Cinnamon Stars together! 🥾
Note: Cinnamon Stars can only be obtained in Official servers.

You can also receive the new items through:
- Random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our Discord server to find traders).

Winterdream 2024 Icon!

Play at least one round of Witch It in an Official server during the Winterdream 2024 event to earn the icon, but be quick - the item will never return once the event is over!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/58e3e0edca4a8ba7d4c2e8cf9e65d8854f3c29ad.jpg

Before we share what we've been working on, we want to express our immense gratitude for your patience while we've worked tirelessly on Dreamland and our upcoming console releases - thank you! Dreamland is our most ambitious project yet, so we truly hope you enjoy what we've created! 💜

Dream Valley Castle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png
Dream Valley Castle is the result of over a year of groundbreaking technical progress and collaborative team growth. We think this map captures the magical and wacky charm of Witch It more than anything we've ever made! Bring your friends, as this is one of our biggest maps to date. 🗺️

Let's take a look at what Dream Valley Castle has to offer...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/db239cb2817ff11f85ddf0dc2ea020c5a1f25c0c.png

The Courtyard
Welcome to the courtyard! The area is divided into four distinct segments, linked by winding corridors and castle walls. At its core, the mysterious Witch Tower looms over the map... 🧙‍♀️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f15f333000ea464192ec93bcb5181d45d558ee87.png

The Seasons
In the courtyard, each segment brings a different season to life, complete with themed props and structures unique to that time of the year. Seamlessly travel between each area by using the portals located at the centre of each seasonal zone! 🌀

🌸 Spring
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/49fce450e1eba0eba807046c7d84d94d44df3065.png

☀️ Summer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2f03b4299a0077b8fbef60e6b37a0e91e1a8c5c5.png

🍂 Autumn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ef349484e97695e0f95ab0c2c25fe632ad32eab3.png

❄️ Winter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4f3660d5f4625c0e001e7f34925d79c8ba20b7a5.png

The Witch Tower
Venture into the mystifying Witch Tower at the centre of the courtyard. Hide up high and out of sight of hunters - the unpredictable magic infesting the tower provides the perfect cover from even the most talented opponents! 🔮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6eedd1abd5c9263293e4fec43068cfb0ff48be59.png

The Castle
Take cover within the castle's beautiful architecture and furnishings, using balconies and rafters to outsmart the hunters! Escape quickly through the corridors, or via the huge double doors leading directly into the Autumn zone. 🕯️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/16ccec0148291fe343e9843629583fa0082c13fe.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1ee4372b9fa8d8da1ff0632c2734fbcf5fead202.png

70+ New Props!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png
Adapt to the surroundings in Dream Valley Castle by transforming into any one of the 70+ new props scattered across the map. Transform into various weaponry, potions, or even disguise yourself in Knight's armour! Blend in effortlessly with the seasonal zones by switching into bushes, beans, or one of the many secret props tucked away out-of-sight! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ea8b84e5141bb562c2b5cfa50d4c44885b407cce.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/766f3a6703b660a7c92867446fcc5b6724052bd5.jpg

We can't wait for you to explore Dream Valley Castle and discover the framed paintings of our outstanding Dreamland Art Contest winners! 🖼️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/948c1602d432d43fc22adcfbf08f7bcf78dcec95.jpg

🥇 1st Place: Morinor
🥈 2nd Place: Andy
🥉 3rd Place: DrRiptide

As well as our Vertical Frame Winners:
🥇 1st Place: Vissia
🥈 2nd Place: Fánkiii
🥉 3rd Place: gedankenkind

As always, thanks to everyone who participated! You can view all entries here. 👀

200+ New Creative Mode Structures!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png
While building Dream Valley Castle, we wanted to empower our map creators with all the essential parts and pieces, so that everyone has the chance to build their own kingdom! Discover more than 200 new arches, towers, walls, bridges, windows, flora, statues, and much more! 🧱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d09276ba6dcd2c749506ae5c58aaba01cbc8d7d8.png

While you get acquainted with the new Creative Mode structures, we're working on 2024's Official Map Contest which will arrive before the end of the year! If you can't wait that long, join the Witch It Discord and prepare for the next community-ran Speed Build contest, arriving a few weeks from now! 💨

Creative Mode QoL
We've made a bunch of useful quality-of-life changes to Creative Mode:

 Change your camera speed by scrolling your mouse wheel.
 Save a selection with ALT + [NUMBER]  You can select the previously saved selection by pressing the corresponding number once.
 Centre the previously saved selection by pressing the corresponding number twice.  Move your camera downwards by using "C".
 Moving props around using the gizmo now follows your mouse speed (no more repeated dragging)!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d608e2f16290b29e640c5cc2a34615024d71032a.gif

In addition, we've added many more material overrides to many of the Dreamland structures - for example, towers placed in a desert map will look different to towers placed in an island map. You can also manually set the material variant using Edit Mode! ⛏️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2b4f0c0b6375925b7d515b4ac6aee9ec2dedceaf.gif

48 New Skins!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png
If you're running around Dream Valley Castle, please come properly dressed (we don't want to upset the King)! Dress up as the marvellous King himself, or an enchanted fairy that blends in with the seasons... or even one of the many horses (don't forget to attach a horn)! All skins can be earned through event crafting, explained below. 🧵

👑 Kings & Knights
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8fe8e78860a61b8f28182e08996c864cda2f1891.jpg

🧚‍♀️ Fairies & Granddaughters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2908a46078a3eef9c39156c078da63c1a0f4e73c.jpg

🐴 Horses & Horns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/01f5a5b1faff2144df05f1f7938f4280949c1317.jpg

How do I craft Dreamland items?
Opening Witch It during the Dreamland event will grant you 30 "Jewellery Boxes"!
A Jewellery Box contains a random Dreamland item, which can only be opened by combining them with "Dreamy Fluff".

To earn Dreamy Fluffs, fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level-up screen.

Dreamy Fluff has a 50% chance of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled, but only if you are currently playing Dream Valley Castle! If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press "Dreamland" to combine it with a Jewellery Box!

Every Dreamland item earned through Jewellery Boxes are tradable and craftable even when the Dreamland event is over. If you use up all your Jewellery Boxes, you can craft more by combining 5 Dreamy Fluff in the event screen.
Note: Dreamy Fluff can only be obtained in Official servers.

You can also receive the new items through:
- As random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our Discord server to find traders).

Dreamland Event Icon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b308b4e1a288b6f495d4360903628bf7f8374229.jpg
Collect the limited-time "Dreamland Event" icon by playing Witch It during the event season. At the end of the Dreamland event, this icon will never return, so make sure to pick it up before it disappears! ⌛

These sets will be released within the next few weeks, and purchasable as a bundle or seperately via the Witch It Steam store page! ✔️

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1 - In-game Trading!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/709d386014f5f3fc2bc895382e2f1fff0fd14ac3.png

We're excited to announce Patch 1.5.1! Send and receive trade offers by using our new in-game trading system, now set-up for cross-platform trading once Witch It releases on consoles later this year. View your inventory in-game, try our new aim-assist for gamepads, and witness improved performance on older PC's. Read on! 🎉

Everything You Need To Know About In-Game Trading:
Enable Public Inventory
In order to receive trade offers, you must first toggle your Witch It account settings to ensure your inventory is visible. To find your account settings, press on your username in the main menu, then press the last tab with the cog icon. Here, you can enable your public inventory:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/33d2e4f4f5795c990ddc5ecdfbd1112651774115.gif

Our brand-new in-game trading system can be found under "Collection" > "Trading" on our new restructured main menu. ⚙️

On this screen, you will find three options to create trade requests, see pending requests, and view your trade history. 🔎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4372a05cd6c0d28d75b33048d527b2c99157f280.jpg
Create Trade Request
Press "Create Trade Request" to open a list containing all your Witch It friends. 🤝

To initiate a trade request, press the handshake icon corresponding with the friend you wish to trade with. In the future, we will add a way for you to trade with non-friends, too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f3c724a9fc303a872630cc501750e6c9991c3cfe.jpg

Select items to trade from your inventory by clicking on them under the "Mine" tab. You can see the active trade offer to the right, and if you want to remove an item just click on it in the offer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0c203562318c67489c9727c2990bbb5f4768952d.jpg

Select items from their inventory by clicking on them under the "Theirs" tab. Once you're ready to send the offer, press "Send Trade Offer" in the bottom right! ✔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b979f9cf6f3b1c22d13c0ee753f2f0ec354e7313.jpg

Important Tips:
- If you are trading away the last of an item you own, a warning triangle will appear around the item quantity. Be careful not to trade away any items you wish to keep! ⚠️
- If an item in an offer is traded away elsewhere, all offers containing that item will automatically cancel. Be careful not to trade away identical items in multiple trades! ❌
- Both players do not need to be online in order to receive or accept trade offers - you can send requests to offline players! 💤

We plan to support WitchTrade in the future! 💜

Pending Trade Requests
Press "Pending Trade Requests" to view all incoming and outgoing trade requests. 📬

On the "Incoming" tab, you can see incoming requests, and accept or reject these by pressing the corresponding buttons to the right of the offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1b1b2efd1c5089cfd59a9feeef3139a04caa214d.jpg

On the "Outgoing" tab, you can see your outgoing requests. Cancel a request by pressing the corresponding button to the right of the offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e7f3ebf688d153b3ea9f198ba16aa5ea993bef0b.jpg

Incoming trading requests will also appear as notifications in-game! 📨

Trade History

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/606c8b1fd3416635ade46d6a05db1cb79b3c128a.jpg

Press "Trade History" to view a detailed list of all your previous trades.

Each trade shows the name and icon of the player you were trading with, a timestamp of the trade, whether it was an incoming or outgoing trade, and the status of the trade. Clicking on a trade will allow you to see what items were swapped, in case you need a quick reminder! 🔄

Inventory
View your entire Witch It inventory by pressing on "Collection" > "Inventory". 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8f381df65c68de8b0dbc923a79043f994a64b4aa.jpg

Press the "Filter" button to filter your inventory by type, team, slot, rarity, or duplicates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/cb69071e1e7c69be34b617ba8511dd2d282c4d82.jpg

Your Steam Inventory is still invisible, as we are still working on solutions for displaying your items without causing issues to our cross-platform system. 🪲

Aim Assist
Struggling to hit fast-moving witches with your controller? 🎮
We've now added an aim assist to help you secure those eliminations!
Aim assist does not work with mouse and keyboard - only gamepads.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3dae17c7f3173d762587b7a78540d1f142716b0a.gif

Aim assist does not lock onto still transformed props, so don't worry - your hiding spot is safe (probably)!

Portal Effects
We've mixed together the finest and rarest ingredients into our portal fluid, releasing a satisfying burst of particles whenever you travel through them! 💫

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d46d6b06c5be31a95487ec6e4e7e42a2d74a4da8.gif

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0 - Creative 2.0!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/917153b010dc84f86ba9d24d89ac35cef1ace2d9.png

Patch 1.5.0 is here! In this update, we're excited to release an early version of our Creative 2.0 that will advance your map creation to unimaginable heights! In addition, we now have a new in-game friends system, and have made a lot of performance optimisations towards CPU and GPU. Check it out! 🎉

Creative 2.0!
Welcome to Creative 2.0, our biggest technical leap to Creative Mode yet! 🚀

You'll immediately notice that Creative 2.0's camera works slightly different from usual. You now use right-click to rotate your camera. This is to keep our creative mode mechanically aligned with other popular creative modes and editing software, and will be much easier for console players to build maps once we enable controller use in the near future. 🕹️

By pressing Tab, you can now open a radial menu that allows you to select from Place, Edit, or Connect modes seamlessly:

🪑 Place Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ad46a11ff44803d75555551356cfc25f62788b1b.jpg
Place Mode is used to place down props, structures and utilities into your map. In Creative 2.0, the placement menu has been condensed so you don't ever have to open and close the menu to see what you're doing. Your position in the placement menu will remain even after placing a prop (unless switching to another tab or mode), allowing for far more efficiency when you go to fill up your maps with props!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6d7bf56c966b3be7bca44cd991681466089b904f.jpg

🔧 Edit Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a7a98fada4579550e1c1eeea84c2a3ee6c1f3f07.jpg
Edit Mode is used to modify specific parameters of your props. As usual, you can click a prop to select it for editing - however, you'll now see a useful properties menu appear in the corner of your screen. For the first time ever since Creative Mode was released, you can now type in specific values for position, rotation and scaling, allowing for mathematically accurate transformation of any prop or structure in your map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a26f3265e5e2823870dd58521efdd0ab31354b60.jpg
Want to equally space out pillars in a building?
Increase one of the position values by 200 each time to create a perfect row! ✔️

Want to create a structures like Twisted House?
Modify the rotation value and copy it to all other props to create weird and wacky designs! ✔️

Need to enable an action prop?
Action props can be activated directly in edit mode! ✔️

🔌 Connect Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e74c6f48f997e6550bd002812aadb0aeea5b1248.jpg
Connect Mode is used to attach switches to switchable props or utilities. In Creative 2.0, you can connect and disconnect objects by shift-clicking them. Easily view all connections on a single switch by selecting the switch in connect mode, and disconnect all or selected connections via the menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6ea48b35d2a9ed9003a7e5ffed124a27db2388e2.jpg

🎮 Play Test
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/52e7ff35fa44aa1966c027b226534d32ea9634fd.jpg

Creative 2.0's Play Test mode allows you to test your creations and push their limits without damaging your hard work. When enabling Play Test via the server menu (ESC), you can now select your team and skills before starting the test. Physics are disabled by default in Creative 2.0, so Play Test is what you'll use to quickly enable physics and test your maps exactly as players will see it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/461347ec91978b8d5eab12846356b7e30fa4b2c2.jpg
After starting the test, you can run around and play your maps as you wish. Knocking over props, using explosive skills like body slam, and breaking your maps is encouraged - as exiting Play Test will revert everything back to normal and return your props to their original positions! ↩️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d0ceedd25b8664ba19269408287b40b6bd3afd07.jpg
Please be aware that this an early iteration of the new Creative Mode, so many things are still not yet finalised. In particular, controller and chat functions do not currently work and will be added in a later update. But there's good news - the Creative Mode structure limit has now been increased from 2000 to 2500! 🧱

Here's some handy shortcut keys that may help you in Creative 2.0:

Press 4 to change to Place Mode
Press 5 to change to Edit Mode
Press 6 to change to Connect Mode
Press 0 to change to Play Test Mode

Friends System!
With the upcoming console release and exploration of new platforms for Witch It, we are introducing a new in-game friends list. You can access it by pressing your profile in the top right of the main menu, or by opening the in-game menu during a match and pressing 'Friends'. 👥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8ce3d9488488ef8c69cf74066d204b3d0215f591.jpg
Here, you can browse your list of in-game, online and offline friends. If you're currently in a match, you'll also have an option to invite your friend to the session. In this menu, you can also find recently played with players, pending friend invites, and account settings. ⚙️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/777a2cf35e8dc787be799f7640734f2d5ecd5a96.jpg
In account settings, you can reveal your User ID and share with your friends to add them! ➕
Adding in-game friends does not affect your Steam friends list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/374a112141711c9a65f875e22e4c95a69b787411.jpg

Major Optimisations!
Players with low-end integrated graphics cards can now select the new "Start with Simple Shaders" launch option when starting Witch It, which will improve performance on old PCs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a4955ec28cb517f7ba229fd4c9b48b8b445c53be.png
Map collision has been entirely replaced with our new map border system, and we made several optimisations on gamecode which will improve CPU performance. 📈

Prop Transform Grace Time
In the in-game settings, there's a new option called "Prop Transform Grace Time". ✨
This refers to the amount of time you can transform into a prop even after it's not highlighted anymore.
While this is mainly for controller users to make it easier to transform while moving, this works just as well for PC players too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/30144670cd6f78eec8d251d28b68dcebb418da8d.gif

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2 - Witch It on Unreal Engine 5!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.4.2 marks the start of Witch It's bright future - the introduction of Unreal Engine 5! In addition, we've improved controller support, and have now made significant progress on many of Witch It's supported languages, as well as added Hungarian, Ukrainian and Galician. Read on! 🎉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6855fb4532a98a1c2484b62dcffe9d902cadbabb.jpg

Unreal Engine 5
As our game grows bigger and better each year, we've been looking for ways to upgrade our technology - so Witch It can remain the best prop hunt experience for many years to come! Unreal Engine 5 empowers us with innovative, new tools to bring our creative vision to life far more efficiently than before. 🚀

The transition to UE5 is mostly seamless for you, the players. Your progress and maps are safe, and you won't see many significant changes to how the game looks and plays at this time, but UE5 will give us far more possibilities in future development!

Witch It now has a new physics engine, which should now feel more stable than before. However, if you find anything that's odd, please do let us know! 📝

What about my computer specifications?
The introduction of Unreal Engine 5 will improve optimisation on mid-to-high tier computers, but is not compatible with Windows 7 or 8. As of January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will no longer run on Windows 7 or Windows 8, so if you are running on an older system, we highly recommend to update it as soon as possible! ✔️

Improved Controller Support
Controller support has been drastically improved across Witch It, and features a new default layout!
Please note that custom key bindings have been reset and will need to be input again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/49d6603f4da0192f050fbd6b9579d6448853720a.jpg

Please give it a try and send us your feedback to our Discord server, our Steam discussions, or in the comments below this announcement. Creative Mode does not have controller support at this time - but we're working on it for a future update! 🎮

Hungarian, Ukrainian and Galician Languages
Within a day or two of our translators announcement, we had over 100 community members reach out to us offering their support towards translating Witch It! Thank you to everyone who reached out to us.

Over the past few weeks, we've been working with many talented new translators on finishing our existing languages. Italian, Korean and Polish are now complete, and Danish, Japanese and Portuguese (Brazil) are not far from finished! 🌍

We also had many community members reach out for us expressing interest in new languages they'd like to see supported. We're excited to announce that we're now supporting Hungarian, Ukrainian and Galician, which are available to use in-game. To change your language, go to Settings > Game > Language.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1 - Custom Map Cycles are here!
notes.notes:
Behold, Patch 1.4.1! Introducing custom map cycles, allowing you to create your own combination of different maps when hosting a custom match and save your favourite cycles for later! In addition, we've introduced new ways of keeping track of your achievements, some possess balancing changes, and spinning weathervanes... check it out below! 📢

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b0aee0a047819a189ca02df5c904da5b1c3d7caf.jpg
[Important] Stats Transfer
All player stats and achievements have now been migrated to our own backend servers instead of Steam. This includes all player progress including levels, prop collection progress, and so on. These stats will automatically transfer upon your first login. ⚠️

If you notice any issues with the stats transfer, please let us know in the comments below this announcement, or in the Witch It Discord.

Custom Map Cycles
Custom map cycles are finally here! You now have the option to create, edit, save and load custom map cycles when hosting a custom match.

Custom map cycles can be made from any combination of Official, Featured, or Custom maps you've created or subscribed to on the Steam Workshop. 🧰

Creating a Map Cycle
To begin, press the "Edit Map Cycle" button when selecting a map to play on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a62daa2c973df28fb64fb29f0effe75b9f363c5e.jpg
You'll now see a new interface appear on the right. Here is where your map cycle will appear!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d4e31cb42c9ab318a965da076560b6390ef6e20f.jpg
Add a map to the cycle by clicking on it in the map list, and remove a map from the cycle by clicking on it in the map cycle preview. Chosen maps display a tick to show that they have been selected. Hit 'Reset' just below the map interface to remove all your choices and start again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b23a31efc87e9964ea84ea7cd33bee40c19fda35.jpg
Select up to 20 maps for your map cycle from any category - mix a few of your favourite Official or Featured maps with a handful of Steam Workshop maps for a undeniably fun time! 🙌

Saving/Loading Map Cycles
Just like Match Rules +, you can save your map cycle configurations and load them later.

To save or load a map cycle, click on the "Save/Load Map Cycle' button while editing a map cycle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4a7e21d3fae8859437be7b999da927154d041012.jpg
Type in the name of your map cycle in the "Map Cycle Name" box, and then press "save".
The map cycle you just named will now appear in the list of saved cycles. 💾

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4d745a6dee0c1c4b1ee5dbff502f0a3c5712c2fe.jpg
You can load a previously saved cycle by clicking on it's name and pressing 'load'.
You can delete a previously saved cycle by clicking on it's name and pressing 'delete'. 🗑️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9ec7959f9ba4da28d682334fd9fe14cd4e1e1df4.jpg
Additional Map Cycle Features
Randomizing Cycles
At the bottom of the map cycle preview, there is a 'random sequence' checkbox.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1745ff0bc894018f307736dffe85b9c69cef478d.jpg
☐ If the box is unchecked: your chosen map cycle will play in a linear sequence, playing each map in order of selection before looping back to the beginning when all maps have been played.

☒ If the box is checked: your chosen map cycle will play in a random sequence, meaning any other map besides the one you are currently playing will be played in the following round.

Duplicate Maps
You can select the same map multiple times when editing a custom map cycle.
This can be used to increase the chances of a specific map appearing in the random sequence, or to repeat specific maps after each round in the linear sequence.

For example, select each map twice so you and your friends can swap sides on the same map before cycling to a new map! 🔄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8a51de54733d2cb4dff017ac751ced995d2a3a53.jpg
Editing Cycles during a Match
Map cycles can be edited mid-game by the host, in case you change your mind about the order or selection of maps. To do so, press the ESC key during a match and click "Next Match Settings" to open up the match settings and access the maps as you would when creating a custom match. Press "Save For Next Match" to apply your map cycle changes once the current round is complete. ✔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/eef274af3b05baf2f963744c6119da27b926abd7.jpg
Achievement Improvements
Achievements now pop-up on screen when you earn them! 🌟

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/171995c56333e9c1ec09d03126aabbd2a893430d.gif

You can now view your achievements and their progress in the "collection" screen on the main menu (just under the Prop Collection button)! 📜

⚠️ Known Issue: Achievement dates are not displaying correctly - this will be fixed in an upcoming hotfix.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/bb5e435f0b521d9552e007aa0597e900f573fd49.png
Possess Balancing
We've made some adjustments to the balancing of the witches' possess skill to keep it as an effective mobility option while ironing out some of the problems that made it far too overpowered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f154c106fb6ba503785fd28bff1d30bb152071e7.gif

Mana Cost
To begin, our patch 1.4.0 changed the visual effects of the possess, significantly reducing the visibility of which direction the witch possessed towards. While we are enjoying this change so far, the time between possesses feels far too short, making escapes a lot less risky than before when combined with the new visual effects. ✨

As a result, we have increased the mana cost of possess from 40 to 50.

Possessed Props
In our last major patch, we made a change that meant players left their original prop behind when possessing a new prop. Originally, this assisted witches in confusing the hunters during a pursuit, but now is very commonly used to scatter huge props - blocking doorways and disrupting the gameplay far more than we intended. ⛔

To fix this while keeping our original idea intact, props left behind by possess now dissolve after 5 seconds, unless they're repossessed. Please give the possess skill a try and let us know what you think!

Weathervanes
Weathervanes now spin when hit by a projectile or touched! 💫

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6887fc6e20f6ef2627c834163b6436c4f8633c6a.gif

Weathervanes can now only be uniformly scaled in Creative Mode to ensure they can spin when your map is being played. If you have any non-uniformly scaled weathervanes in your maps, they will be adjusted when loading the map to ensure their functionality. Weathervanes will not spin while your map is being edited in Creative Mode, but will function once you are playing your map in a custom match.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Modify your lobbies with Match Rules +!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Patch 1.4.0, featuring Match Rules +, one of our biggest additions since 1.0! We're also excited to announce the wardrobe, a new utility that allows players to switch up their skills and sets mid-round. And as always, we've packed in a bunch of changes and additions - read on! 🎉

https://i.imgur.com/MsZAMLT.gif

Match Rules +
Introducing Match Rules +, a brand new way to modify your custom matches! Change a huge array of different parameters to design a unique match like no other. You can even save and load your favourite configurations for future use! ✨

To access Match Rules +, simply start a custom match through the main menu and select the "Match Rules +" option at the bottom of the screen. From there, you can adjust a range of variables across three tabs: General, Skills, and Game Modifiers. See below for a brief overview of each tab.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7f9f3e4eb099cc704c949191830a5ba2bb4488c4.jpg

General Configurations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/dda919ca646b47f7ca2377a9c11da012e693b3b5.jpg

On the first tab, you can change the fundamental parameters of your match, such as gravity, movement speed, jump height, player size, and more. 🔧

Move each slider according to your preferences, or enter a specific value in the boxes to the right of each slider. In case you wish to undo a change, click the ↺ button beside each parameter, or select the "reset all to default" button to revert all alterations you've made.

https://i.imgur.com/RV4I5Um.gif
✔️ Become a colossal Hunter using the player size multiplier!

https://i.imgur.com/TJqojWE.gif
✔️ Lower the gravity and cause chaos!

Skill Configurations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/808fbbf837e5067d79ce770b94908b0ad43c574d.jpg

On the second tab, you can modify specific skill parameters, as well as the Hunter's melee and projectiles. Here, you can alter the damage, velocity, radius, mana cost and much more for each individual skill, as well as disable skills you don't want players in your match to use. 🥔

https://i.imgur.com/JLUWzSc.gif
✔️ Buff the mushroom split amount, but reduce the confusion time!

https://i.imgur.com/gkZLwS6.gif
✔️ Increase the Hunter's projectile amount, speed and spread, but lower the damage!

Game Modifiers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1b7f274444e5278403b4df8e593cdd3cc04fecc7.jpg

On the third tab, you can find our "game modifiers" - these are special modifiers that drastically change the gameplay of your match! Patch 1.4.0 comes with three game modifiers:

🔹 Move It
All witches have to move to survive.

https://i.imgur.com/YaMqeAS.gif

🔹 Dissolving Props
Props will start disappearing over time.

https://i.imgur.com/VXqzuUU.gif

🔹 Prop Retaliation
Hitting non-Witch props will deal damage to Hunters.

https://i.imgur.com/HTXFWNT.gif

To enable a game modifier, click on the corresponding modifier you wish to use and toggle the "Is enabled" parameter. Each modifier also has a few changeable parameters you can experiment with! 🧪

Save and Load Match Rules +
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1e54e71b9012bbc6caf8b010e8791be3d47f6492.jpg

In the bottom right of the Match Rules + configuration, there is a button labelled "Save/Load Match Rules +". Once clicked, it will take you to a new screen where you can name and save your Match Rules + configuration. You can revisit this area anytime to overwrite your saved Match Rules +, or load a previous one you've created! 💾

Tweak Match Rules + During Custom Matches
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2ce3a9974b729afd0c90cc8090726a83d60c10df.jpg

When starting a custom match, hosts can now find a new toggle on the page named "Tweakable Match Rules +". Enabling this toggle allows the host to modify parameters in real-time by accessing the in-game menu during a round and clicking the "Match Rules +" button, as shown below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ec15c776f9c51ade51ed8ddf1ca4155c7e5b9378.jpg

For players wanting to try Match Rules +, we highly recommend enabling this option and experimenting with the different modifiers and parameters! Changes you make will take effect immediately, without requiring a server restart. So, feel free to get creative and see what kind of unique gameplay experiences you can come up with! 🧰

https://i.imgur.com/Pp7a7TR.gif
✔️ Tweak the rules while playing to find the perfect combination, then save your changes!

Swap Skills & Sets Using The Wardrobe
You can now swap your skills and custom sets during a match using the new 'wardrobe', found in the Hunter spawn of all Official and Featured Maps! A quick switch of your skill selection and appearance during play gives you the flexibility to adapt to any situation. And for our map creators: the wardrobe will be added to Creative Mode in a future update! 👖

https://i.imgur.com/rVCGHcd.gif

Custom Match Search Time Capacity Increased
The maximum search time in custom matches has been increased from 10 to 20 minutes, for those wanting to play extra long rounds with less pressure of running out of time! ⏰

https://i.imgur.com/DyRo3kP.gif

Extinguishable Props
Props that emit fire or smoke are now extinguished when they touch water! 🌊

https://i.imgur.com/Cl08yoe.gif

In addition, we've added a temporary Classic Prop Hunt mode on multiple servers to demonstrate the potential of Match Rules +. This mode features no skills for both teams and Hunters are damaged when they attack non-Witch props, but can scan props using melee as much as they want. Give it a try and let us know what you think! 🎮

We'd love to see what wild ideas you come up with Match Rules +, so please share your screenshots and videos with us over on our Steam Hub or our Discord server! 💜

notes.title: Patch 1.3.6 - Introducing 6 Faraway Lands Maps!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.3.6 is here, and we're finally ready to reveal our Faraway Lands | Official Map Contest 2022 winners... as well as introducing 7 new structures, skill effects, a long-awaited recipe, and more!

Faraway Lands Results!
[previewyoutube=tyle4DBbuCo;full][/previewyoutube]
A few months back, we ran our 3rd ever map creation contest, named "Faraway Lands". Participants were tasked with creating a small-scale map suitable for 4-8 players, with just over a month to prepare their entries... ⌛

This time around, rather than providing a set visual theme, participants were able to let their creativity run wild and build as they like, as long as it was suitable for 4-8 players. With minimal reference to inspire this size of map, this was arguably our most difficult map contest yet. We discovered that each map creator had a vastly different approach to the player restriction; from the actual map size, to the prop density, or even utilising game mechanics like jump pads to help players traverse large sections. For clarification, the recommended player count for all winning Faraway Lands maps has been adjusted to 4-10 players in the map selection and voting screens - a little larger than we initially expected, but we hope this clears things up.

Each winner will shortly receive a Witch It Steam key, 10x Crystallized Moonlight, their name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure (the new "metal wall"), and the fabled "Grand Architect" title within our community!

We decided the winners based on a range of different factors, such as aesthetics and functionality, but map size was at the forefront of this choice. All maps were played with a lobby containing 8 judges (all from Barrel Roll Games), and our decision was made without bias towards any one creator or team. However, to prevent creators taking multiple winning spots in future contests, we are considering changing our rules for the near future. So if you didn't win this time around, don't feel disheartened - we'd love to have you back! 🎉

All winning maps are now available to play in any Hide & Seek, Mobification, or Hunt a Hag Official server, or by pressing on the "Featured Maps" tab when setting up a custom match. ✔️

Our Winners!
🥇 Singing Sanctuary
Created by Farbenkeks
“Ancient magic lingers in Singing Sanctuary and keeps the place evergreen.”

Following Precious Palaces, Farbenkeks took home a well-deserved win with Vermilion Valley, cementing themselves in the community as one of it's most talented map builders. While Singing Sanctuary is thematically far different to their previous entry, Farbenkeks' close attention to detail and imaginative use of structures returns once again in its full glory. Congratulations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/018979a62fc627d4aa862a18fd8ddd5f82c7cd83.jpg

“After a fateful run-in with a sea behemoth, The Coven of the Trade Winds washed ashore this tropical island. Shipwrecked and stranded, they've built a new life for themselves in the shelter of a small cove.” [Full Story]

Coven's Cove is CDJS and NotSure's debut entry to our map contests, and we're very impressed with what they've created! The landscape is relatively minimalist, yet greatly satisfying to traverse and hide within. Fans of Loakiki Paradise will find Coven's Cove familiar and comfortable to explore, but will need to be even more cunning with their hiding spots, since the cove is one of our smallest maps to date. Well done!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/93be7d03910571b6c331bf2f0fca41bc53da22e4.jpg

🥇 Bone Pit
Created by Reekyu
“A wooden fortress built on a fossil filled island.”

Reekyu never fails to miss a map contest, and subsequently never fails to miss out on a winning spot! Bone Pit is a masterpiece in both form and function; the map is visually stunning and extremely easy to navigate, with well placed pathways and jump pads. While on the larger-size compared to other winners, the jump pads allow Hunters to quickly travel across the map while scanning for hidden Witches. Great work, Reekyu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e8a59a17942a057cf929aab330872815af65f195.jpg

🥇 Ancient Temple
Created by Reekyu
“An ancient temple cursed with dark magic.”

Reekyu's second winning map of Faraway Lands is Ancient Temple, a dark and creepy interior-only map that's not for the weak-stomached. Look up, and you may see a spiders web so thickly-spun that even the temple's fallen stones haven't breached it's surface... amazing job!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/55822d2f7b5f232447e4f91ec429afe685092310.jpg

🥇 Martin’s Chamber
Created by Gelato & Emote
“Martin's Chamber aka "Odaia lui Martin””

Gelato and Emote, previous winners of Precious Palaces with Kasbah le Ribat, make a surprise return to Faraway Lands with Martin's Chamber! Enter an abandoned, overgrown mansion on an estate long-forgotten, and seek shelter within its ivy walls. Martin's Chamber makes clever use of structures to create a building that doesn't feel prefabricated... simply impressive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4d8bdf518d13e9c1ba18fe65e69fcdd1014a0b02.jpg

🥇 Sunset Swamp
Created by Reekyu
“Built on the edge of a swamp sits the home of a lonely, but happy hunter.”

Sunset Swamp is Reekyu's third and final winning map of Faraway Lands - we just couldn't shake the feeling that this one deserved to be among our winners too! A thick, dense swamp surrounds a hand-crafted settlement built from its surrounding resources. Take shelter indoors, or hide under the vines and shrubbery scattered across the swampland. Excellent work!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/14c731cfd1d8788e793840d59cf8374192784559.jpg

As expected from our talented building community, all entries this contest were remarkable and consequently difficult to judge. Every entry we received deserved a win in their own unique ways. However, we wanted to showcase a few of our favourites that didn't make the final cut.

Positive reactions to our Alpha and Beta testing periods gave us a spark of confidence we desperately needed to hit that button, no matter how daunting the following journey may be. So we're not going anywhere. In fact, we're doubling down.
We've taken substantial steps over the past year to multiply the size of our development team, so we can continue working on Witch It for the years to come! We strongly believe our best years are still ahead of us. So whether you're a new player or a seasoned veteran, we hope you stick with us!

The Djinn's twin brother is finally satisfied. The world met his cries with countless palaces to pick from. Without rest, the Djinn's twin brother scooped up the keys to his 6 favourite palaces and ran off into the sunset without delay...

All entrants, winners or not, will receive the bonus "Pyramid Hat" reward shortly!

🥇 Lost Temple
Created by ShadZ
"Thousands of years ago, the Temple of Aetes was once a magnificent and resplendent temple in the middle of the desert. The temple was surrounded by plentiful water and fertile land, which they owe to the magic of Aetes and crystals. However, this magic disappeared from time to time. Increasingly frequent sandstorms destroyed the temple in all possible parts. After a while, the temple sank into the ground and disappeared. Only a small oasis remains. A Rumor says that the spirit of Aetes still lurks within the halls of the temple."

🥇 Oasis Temple

We wish to steal as many crystals as we can from the temple to repurpose it in our own technology. However, the witches are upset and have returned to the temple to enact their revenge. Catch these pesky witches, and we will reward you with countless riches beyond your imagination!"

At the end of the endless desert where the golden horizon turns red, the Vermilion Valley streches to the darkness of forgotten shadows. Legend has it that somewhere in the valley lies a powerful source of magic. In no other place did the Djinn build a palace to meet many guests and to pass the time with games.

The reputation of the wonderful new palace finally reached his brother who could not hide his envy: "No one will ever have a more beautiful palace than me!" he shouted and sent out his army.

notes.title: Precious Palaces Community Voting Results & Main Prize Update
notes.notes:
Today, we're revealing the results of the Precious Palaces Official Map Contest 2021 community vote, and providing an update about the main prize winners that will be revealed soon.

🗳️ Community Voting Results

Following the deadline of the Precious Palaces contest, we tasked our community to cast votes for their favourite maps. Votes were split into three categories and the winner of each category with the most votes will receive a bonus prize of 10 crystallized moonlight, as well as their name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure! Please note that maps that win the community vote are not guaranteed to be implemented in-game.

✔️ Our Categories:

🎲 = Quality Gameplay - This map is fun to play and feels balanced!
🎨 = Artistic Masterpiece - This map is attractive and enticing to look at!
💡 = Creative Visionary - This map contains interesting and unique ideas!

On Jan 31st, we tallied up all votes at exactly 12:00am UTC and located our winners!

🎲 Precious Palaces | Quality Gameplay Award

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/83ae4d4d8f8f03de3c6423a13ee74139f1a1a420.png
🏆 Palace of Heka
Created by Reekyu

Palace of Heka was a popular vote for it's fascinating approach to gameplay and appealing structural layout. The map contains a great mixture of indoor and outdoor areas as well as well-placed jump pads, perfect for a seasoned Hunt a Hag player. A Santorini-like structure is utilised with many rooftops and passages perfect for a quick escape. As one of the previous winners of the 2020 Map Contest, Reekyu has proven yet again that they are exceptionally talented at creating compelling experiences in our map creator. Well done!

🎨 Precious Palaces | Artistic Masterpiece Award

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7842760c479787a94001b2a00ab89d172e0af819.png
🏆 Vermilion Valley (Joint Winner)
Created by Farbenkeks & David / Cubey

Vermilion Valley took Witch It's Creative Mode to the limits, with it's spectacular use of structures and props for exquisite detail. Two colossal stone dragons tower over the map, and the buildings use an effective mixture of sandstone and brick to create a unique aesthetic alongside carefully placed lights and cloth to simulate windy sand dunes. There's so many tiny details here that we couldn't fit it all in this paragraph - go check out this masterpiece created by Farbenkeks and Cubey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/881ffe418e20256e86c9af32039ce8429fde13db.png
🏆 Cress and Gold (Joint Winner)
Created by Farbenkeks

Cress and Gold is the joint winner of the artistic masterpiece award, and was also won by Farbenkeks! This map features a flying palace that had collapsed in a swamp following a nasty thunderstorm. The result is a stunning mixture of prestigious, steampunk-inspired buildings and grungy marshes. The palace is tied together by various ropes and bridges, while toxic pools made from cauldrons span the ground below. Thank you to Farbenkeks for this wondrous map!

💡 Precious Palaces | Creative Visionary Award

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e5f98f445cc76c860f9937014f3eed3373a93d68.png
🏆 Tower of Oceanet
Created by Oceanman, Ekusas, Mudkip and Dunkeroos

Tower of Oceanet is the champion of the creative visionary award, in which Oceanman and their crew were successful in providing a distinctive and peculiar approach to the contest theme. The central tower is made up of magical levitating layers, and surrounded by numerous hovering islands that players can travel to and from using jump pads. Alongside the tornado that sends falling players spiralling through the sky, Tower of Oceanet is a movement player's dream and a unseen approach to the typical gameplay format. To Oceanman, Ekusas, Mudkip and Dunkeroos - well done!

Please congratulate our talented community vote winners!
Your prizes will be sent out once the main prize results are announced (soon).

📢 Main Prize Update

We're having a really tough time picking from all of your incredible entries for our main prizes - each map brings something unique and exciting to the mix and it has been a pleasure judging them!

See for yourself by subscribing to the Precious Palaces Entries Collection here!

Today, we are excited to announce that more than 3 maps will be eligible for in-game implementation to our Official servers. This means we will have more than three main prize winners! However, because of this change, we will need a little more time to decide. We also want to make clear that gameplay will be a important part of judging just as much as visuals, so aspects such as prop placement, prop density and map layout will play a crucial part in these choices. 

We are also working on an additional reward for all our architects, as an additional thank you for all your incredible efforts.

We will reveal this reward alongside the results of our main prize this week (assuming we don't run into any further complications). Hang tight! ːluaqː

Changes to the Crafting System:
We changed the way special ingredients drop.
Before chances where:
   60% ingredient
   25% skin item
   8% recipe
   7% special ingredient
Now a drop works like:
   60% ingredient
   30% skin item
   10% recipe

notes.title: Patch 0.6.2
notes.notes:
-Added: Magic Dust. Magic Dust can be collected during a match and provides bonus XP. For Witches the Magic Dust will drop randomly during a game. If a Hunter catches a Witch, she will drop the amount of Magic Dust she collected so far, but without losing her own Magic Dust.

-Changed: Added a passive to Body slam, so that hunters can jump 50% higher and have 600% more air control.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.3
notes.notes:
For this Patch we focused on skills including 2 new skills and improvements to the existing skills

Skill Update:

-Added “Body Slam” skill for the hunter (unlocked at level 15). With this skill, the hunter can use his mass to deal AoE damage.


http://i.imgur.com/krCjk79.gif 



-Added “Possess” skill for the witch (unlocked at level 13). With this skill, the witch can become an existing prop, so that she will move directly to its location.


http://i.imgur.com/9dcq8PW.gif 


-Changed: Decoy will now spawn the prop you are currently mimicking.
-Changed: Decoy activation cost increased to 20, cost per second decreased to 4 and mana regeneration increased to 10 per second. Overall the decoy can now stay active for 20 seconds.
-Changed: Magic Blocker gets now pulled by magic like a magnet.
-Changed Melee Attack in various ways: Increased the cooldown to 0.5 seconds and added a charge, which can be used to push props and to hit witches hiding in corners which are difficult to reach for the hunter. Fixed the range, so it will now hit props which are really targeted.

-Fixed: It should not be possible anymore to use melee skill and throwing a potato at the same time.


General:

-Added a new death camera, which shows more clearly that you just got killed.
-Added volumetric fog to most levels. This improves visuals but decreases performance a bit. However, on low or medium settings it won't be used.
-Added a Keybinding for the active skill, so you can rebind it.
-Added new Patchnote notifications, so you never miss a new patch.
-Added unlock levels to unlock item descriptions.
-Added a short blinking when the hunter hits a prop, so the player can clearly see which prop got checked.
